site.title: TRPA Maps
site.subtitle: Mapping applications of the Tahoe Regional Planning Agency

categories.name: Planning
categories.description: Zoning, local plans, housing, and shoreline maps supporting the Regional Plan.

categories.name: Transportation
categories.description: Transit, active transportation, safety, and travel data for the Regional Transportation Plan.

categories.name: Permitting
categories.description: Parcel lookup, permit records, and property information tools.

categories.name: Environmental Improvement
categories.description: Environmental Improvement Program (EIP) maps for stormwater, forest health, and restoration.

categories.name: Tools
categories.description: Interactive mapping and analysis apps built by TRPA.

categories.name: Monitoring
categories.description: Environmental threshold, lake clarity, climate resilience, wildfire, and smoke dashboards tracking conditions in the Tahoe Basin.

categories.name: Data & Developers
categories.description: Open data, service directories, and resources for GIS users and developers.

apps.title: Local Plans and Zoning
apps.description: Explore zoning for the Lake Tahoe Region. Click individual plan area statements, community plans, and area plans for zoning information and links to plan documents.

apps.title: What Can I Do on My Parcel?
apps.description: Enter an address or APN to see the zoning district, tolerance district, special designations, and the full list of permitted uses for any parcel in the Basin.

apps.title: Where Can I Build?
apps.description: Pick a use category, then a specific use type, to see every zoning district in the Basin where that use is permitted or conditionally approved, with density limits and plan details.

apps.title: Transportation Map
apps.description: Existing and proposed transit routes, active transportation facilities, areas identified for safety improvements, crash locations, and electric vehicle charging stations.

apps.title: Transportation Tracker
apps.description: Lake Tahoe Info module tracking progress on the Regional Transportation Plan: transit ridership, trail use, vehicle miles traveled, and other performance measures.

apps.title: Housing Resources
apps.description: Housing resources web map for the Tahoe Region.

apps.title: Housing Progress Since 2012
apps.description: Multifamily, deed-restricted, and accessory dwelling units built since the 2012 Regional Plan, by jurisdiction, plus the project pipeline. Map, charts, featured projects, and a filterable table joined live to parcel and vacation home rental services.

apps.title: Deed Restriction Explorer
apps.description: Map and grid for browsing deed-restricted parcels across the Basin. Filter by restriction type, status, and county; search by APN, description, or address; export to CSV.

apps.title: CCCB EIS Cumulative Projects
apps.description: Cumulative project parcels and the five focal scenic viewpoints from the visual analysis in the Cultivating Community, Conserving the Basin (CCCB) Environmental Impact Statement.

apps.title: CCCB EIS Cumulative Projects (Tahoe Living)
apps.description: The same cumulative project parcels and focal viewpoints, styled in the Tahoe Living brand for housing and community engagement contexts.

apps.title: Shoreline Plan Map
apps.description: Current inventory of shoreline structures, natural features, and environmental constraints along the 72 miles of Lake Tahoe shoreline.

apps.title: Permit Review Map
apps.description: Displays the map layers necessary to review a TRPA permit application.

apps.title: Parcel and Permit Records
apps.description: Look up parcel details, permit records, land capability, and coverage information on Lake Tahoe Info.

apps.title: Permit Completeness Review
apps.description: Enter a TRPA application file number to pull the parcel details on record and check a permit application for completeness. Built with Emulate Cities.

apps.title: EIP Projects Map
apps.description: Every Environmental Improvement Program (EIP) project with a known location on an interactive 2D and 3D map. Filter by focus area, stage, watershed, jurisdiction, program, and funding source.

apps.title: EIP Funding Priorities
apps.description: Build the EIP priority lists together: working groups mark projects Priority 1, 2, or 3 with a funding request on a Lake Tahoe Restoration Act (LTRA) list and an Other list, picks combine across reviewers, and the result exports in the master sheet layout.

apps.title: EIP Project Tracker
apps.description: Lake Tahoe Info module with the full record of Environmental Improvement Program (EIP) projects: descriptions, partners, funding, accomplishments, and the EIP 5-Year Project List.

apps.title: Stormwater Tools
apps.description: Lake Tahoe Info module for the Lake Clarity Crediting Program: urban catchments, stormwater treatment and load reduction modeling, and jurisdiction credit tracking.

apps.title: BMP Mapping Tool
apps.description: View best management practices (BMPs) layers, catchments, and APN labels. Locate parcels by address, APN, or catchment name and export selections.

apps.title: Tahoe SEZ Viewer
apps.description: Stream environment zone (SEZ) baseline condition assessment web map for the Lake Tahoe Basin.

apps.title: Watch Duty
apps.description: Real-time wildfire alerts, incident maps, evacuation orders, and air quality for California and Nevada, reported by Watch Duty's volunteer and staff reporters. Not a TRPA product.

apps.title: 48-Hour Smoke Forecast
apps.description: Smoke forecast for the Tahoe Basin and surrounding region, updated every 24 hours by the National Weather Service. Concentrations reported in micrograms per cubic meter.

apps.title: Smoke Forecast and Air Quality
apps.description: Prototype replacement for the 48-hour smoke forecast, rebuilt on the current ArcGIS Maps SDK with live standalone layers in place of a stored web map. Adds evacuation zones, satellite hot spots and smoke plumes, and the hourly AirNow air quality surface alongside monitors and low-cost sensors.

apps.title: Parcel Change Explorer
apps.description: Follow any parcel from 2012 to today: residential units, tourist accommodation units, commercial floor area, zoning, and land use by year, with the current assessor record. Compare two years to build and download a parcel-level change table.

apps.title: Public Notice List
apps.description: Build the owner mailing list for a public notice. Pick the subject parcels, set a notice distance, review who is inside it, and export a CSV, Avery mailing labels, and a map of the notice area.

apps.title: Project Locator
apps.description: Make consistent, branded locator maps for presentations and reports. Search an address, APN, or EIP project, pick a style and layout, and export a PowerPoint slide or PNG.

apps.title: Map Maker
apps.description: Interactive web map for exploring TRPA datasets. Turn layers on and off and export a map to PDF.

apps.title: Story Map Gallery
apps.description: Gallery of narrative story maps published by TRPA on ArcGIS Online. Loads live from TRPA's organization, newest first.

apps.title: Nearmap Imagery
apps.description: High-resolution aerial imagery in Nearmap MapBrowser, updated multiple times per year. Requires a TRPA Nearmap account.

apps.title: Tahoe Data Inventory
apps.description: Searchable inventory of every data asset across Tahoe Open Data, LT Info, TRPA REST services, and eight partner agencies. Rebuilt automatically each month.

apps.title: Open Data Policy and Developer Guide
apps.description: How to use and access data published on tahoeopendata.org, including attribution, delivery channels, and developer examples.

apps.title: Threshold Dashboard
apps.description: Lake Tahoe Info module reporting status and trend for every environmental threshold standard adopted for the Tahoe Region, from the most recent Threshold Evaluation.

apps.title: Monitoring Dashboard
apps.description: Lake Tahoe Info module with the environmental monitoring indicators tracked by TRPA and partners, including data downloads and method documentation.

apps.title: Climate Resilience Dashboard
apps.description: Lake Tahoe Info module tracking 33 climate resilience metrics across greenhouse gas emissions, air quality, forest health, and resilient systems for the Tahoe Basin.

apps.title: Lake Clarity Tracker
apps.description: Lake Tahoe Info module on Lake Tahoe clarity: annual Secchi depth, the drivers of clarity loss, and progress toward the clarity restoration target.

apps.title: Tahoe Open Data
apps.description: Regional geographic data warehouse for the Tahoe Basin. Download GIS data and connect to shared services.

apps.title: ArcGIS REST Services
apps.description: ArcGIS Server REST services directory for developers building on TRPA data.
